Supercharged Supernova!

August 11, 2005

Everything is furiously blinding and fucking awesome! [Song in Ear :: City Of blinding light-U2 ::: Supercharged Supernova!…I AM BACK!]
It’s just a beautiful day for obscured and obfuscated reasons of human mind..but then “atleast” it is!!
[volume :: 100%; singing inside head ] sssss cityssssssss of blinding light sssssss [guy in next cubicle stands up, and give a puzzled look over muffled noise of beats!…volume 85%]
I feel like showing him my fucking finger.. but nah… it’s a “beautiful day!” yaaaayyyy!! [Song:: Don’t phunk with my heart - Black Eyed Peas :: adrenalin pumping in veins]
Yo’s parents will be arriving today. no booze for long time.. don’t care. Not right now. I am the euphoric kid of “present” and i want to live this moment. Yesterday, i couldn’t get lost, and today i don’t want to. [Song :: Speed of light - Coldplay :: Mellow but yappy]
If there is something which can brighten up darkest of my days then it’s definitely “good songs” [and not friends.. as i wrote in one of my poems!] :-D
I am high on life and I have attained the final emancipation of the soul from transmigration, and consequently a beatific enfranchisement from the evils of worldly existence, as by annihilation or absorption into the divine. OR basikally FUCKING NIRVANA!! BRING IT ON WORLD… Here i am!! [high five in head! :-) ]
